entities.name: Adela Jušić
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Adela Jušić is a Bosnian contemporary visual artist. She was born in Sarajevo. She is known for her socially engaged art on the subject of the war in Bosnia and Herzegovina and the role of partisan women during the Second World War in Yugoslavia. She has exhibited her works in more than 100 international exhibitions including: Frestas – Trienal de Artes, The Women's Room, Balkan Artist Guild (London), Manifesta 8. (Murcia), ISCP, Videonale (Bonn), Image Counter Image (München). Jušić is a cofounder of the Association for Art and Culture Crvena.
